findings.title: Journal search containing an apostrophe fails with a server error (search term pasted into SQL)
findings.expected: Searching O'Brien lists the existing entry "Mrs O'Brien said water daily"
findings.actual: GET /api/journal?q=O'Brien returns 500 (no CORS headers, so the browser reports a network failure) and the page shows only 'Could not load the journal.'. backend/routers/journal.py builds the LIKE clause with an f-string, so the search term goes straight into the SQL; a term like x' OR '1'='1 is not treated as plain text either (that request reset the connection).
